attributes.context: Section 24 describes an Employer-implemented GPS routing system for the truck fleet that monitors and records vehicle location, time, speed, and distance, and may be used to assess route deviations, stops, or speed-limit violations.

extraction_text: A by-product of the system is that it is possible to determine if a driver is diverting from his established route, spending excessive time at any location, or exceeding the maximum speed limit. Such information will be used for purposes of progressive discipline including counseling, documented verbal warning, written warning, suspension, and/or termination.
